entries.text: When someone is assigned to a sub-work item, they are now added to the parent work item too (all the way up), and to the modules those work items belong to.
If you work on a sub-work item, you can now add more sub-work items straight from its parent, even when the parent is not yours.
New projects and departments are private by default.
Directors only see approval requests for work items created by a manager or above. Everything else goes to the supervisors and managers of that department.
Renaming a department now renames its project and Wiki folder, and the folder takes the project's icon. Existing departments were synced.
